subject: ONE hyena in a sweat-dark work shirt, long grin, wiry legs, treading the great wheel on the spot in split boots, never held in one pose
second_characters: ONE vulture clerk riding the wheel rim beside him, unrolling a longer bill in EVERY beat and swinging it past the lens; A CROWD of debtors hauling ledger crates past the lens in EVERY beat

props.big: ONE great wooden wheel as broad as the frame, turning under his paws in EVERY beat; from 5.90 ONE split boot with three holes worn clean through the sole
props.small: A SWARM of loose bill paper, grit and feathers tearing past the lens

environment: a walled payout yard stacked wheel to wheel with ledger crates and queueing debtors, packed top and bottom, no open sky
lighting: hard midday daylight, dust in the air, cyan edge left, amber fill right
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the hyena fills at least half its height in EVERY beat, his grin never under a quarter of it. He treads the great wheel on the spot and it turns under him in EVERY beat, spinning the yard around him while he stays centred. The world flies at him: bill paper, grit, the clerk and the debtors tear past the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat. The camera never stops, new shot size every beat, medium to very close. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word done by 5.30, then the wheel carries it
audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opening on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: ra-BO-tal ne po-kla-DA-ya LAP, po-lu-CHIL TOL-ko mo-ZO-li i SCHOT

timeline.a: he drives the wheel over with both forepaws, throwing his chest down into the stride, bill paper tearing past the lens
the clerk rides the rim up beside him unrolling a longer bill across the lens while he shoulders the wheel round
he pounds the wheel round under his paws, hurling his whole body down into every stride, while the clerk and the debtors tear past the lens the full frame width
the clerk slaps the bill roll against his chest and he bats it away without breaking stride
still treading, he hooks a hind paw up to his chest and rips the split boot off it

he rams the sole at the lens first thing, three holes worn clean through it with daylight burning through each, the sole filling the frame and his grin behind it, while the clerk and the debtors pull away into the yard
he hurls the boot past the lens and the clerk catches it and pins a fresh paper to it
he treads the wheel round barefoot, the yard sweeping past the lens
the clerk wedges a bill into the spokes and he stamps it flat mid-stride as the wheel drags it round past the lens
he drives the wheel over harder still, the debtors tearing past the lens

must_appear: at 0.00 both forepaws driving the great wheel over on the spot; at 2.90 him pounding the wheel round as the debtors tear past the lens; at 5.90 the split boot ripped off his hind paw; at 6.60 the holed sole filling the frame with daylight through three holes
negative_prompt: printed text, cyrillic words, digits, subtitles, speech bubble, a hero running at the camera on his feet, a travelling camera, a conveyor belt, a cart, rails, a parked camera, a still or empty background, bare sky, a wide shot, a small distant hero, letterbox, a horizontal 16:9 picture, night, a hero back to the camera, a hero held in one pose, a yoke bar held across the frame, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 5.30, offscreen narration, English speech, a second hyena in frame
